SessionStart.command: node -e "let s=''; process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{ const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); let roots=[]; try{const j=JSON.parse(s||'{}');roots=Array.isArray(j.workspacePaths)?j.workspacePaths:[];}catch{} if(!roots.length)roots=[process.cwd()]; const artifacts=['.scratch/handoff.md','docs/sprint/HANDOFF.md','docs/sprint/SPRINT.md','CONTEXT.md']; const found=[]; let contextUnindexed=false; for(const root of roots){for(const rel of artifacts){try{const p=path.join(root,rel);if(fs.existsSync(p)){found.push(rel);if(rel==='CONTEXT.md'){const body=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(/_\[(?:To be indexed|Defined|exact )/i.test(body))contextUnindexed=true;}}}catch{}}} const notes=[...new Set(found)]; const steps=[]; if(notes.length){ const resumeOrder=['.scratch/handoff.md','docs/sprint/HANDOFF.md','docs/sprint/SPRINT.md'].filter(f=>notes.includes(f)); let instr=''; if(resumeOrder.length){ instr=' Read '+resumeOrder.join(', ')+' first to resume the active ticket/wave.'; } else if(contextUnindexed){ instr=' CONTEXT.md is still an unindexed template: run /index-project (or node .agents/skills/index-project/scripts/scan-repo.mjs) before writing code.'; } else { instr=' Consult CONTEXT.md for the codebase index, config/logging seams, shared UI/helpers, and domain invariants.'; } steps.push({systemMessage:{systemMessage:'[AAC V6 SessionStart] Active workspace artifacts detected: '+notes.join(', ')+'.'+instr}}); } if(String(process.env.AAC_PERSONA||'').toLowerCase()==='neutral')steps.push({systemMessage:{systemMessage:'[AAC V6 SessionStart] AAC_PERSONA=neutral is active. Respond in direct, clinical Principal Engineer prose: zero sycophancy, zero slang, full verification proof.'}}); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({injectSteps:steps})+'\n'); });"
